meta.name: Unofficial Return to Night of the Zealot - Investigator Expansion
meta.description: A full rework of the five Core Set investigators, along with a complete support set to reinforce early archetypes from the Core through The Forgotten Age. This set includes 124 new cards total, 6 investigators, each with unique signature cards, 9 level 0 and 9 upgraded cards for each class, 12 neutral cards and 3 basic weaknesses.
meta.author: seymour9297

cards.name: Roland Banks
cards.text:
[reaction] After you successfully investigate: Place 1 ammo token on a <trait>Firearm</trait> asset you control. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If this skill test is successful during an attack, discover a clue at your location.
cards.flavor: "If I stir up trouble, Sheriff, it will be because there's trouble to stir up.”
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, cards with "investigate", and/or "clue" level 0-2, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Roland's .38 Special, Cover Up, 1 random basic weakness. Deckbuilding Restrictions: No Mystic cards ([mystic]), Illicit cards, Criminal cards or Trick cards.
cards.back_flavor: Roland had always taken comfort in procedure and rules. As an agent in the Bureau, he was relieved to have guidelines to follow in any given situation. But lately, his Federal Agent's Handbook had been entirely unhelpful given the cases he'd been assigned. Try as he might, Roland could find no mention of what to do when confronted with strange creatures, gates through time and space, or magic spells. If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, he would never have believed it... and there's no way his superiors would understand.

cards.name: Roland's .38 Special
cards.text: Roland Banks deck only. Advanced. Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. As an additional cost to initiate this ability, you may place 1 of your clues on your location to have this attack deal +2 damage. If this attack defeats an enemy, you may immediately Investigate your location.

cards.name: Cover Up
cards.text: Roland Banks deck only. Advanced. Revelation - Put Cover Up into play in your threat area. If an enemy has been defeated this round, you cannot discover clues until the end of the round. [action][action] Place 1 of your clues on your location: Discard Cover Up.

cards.name: Ithaca 37.
cards.text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. You may spend 1 additional ammo as part of this action. If you do, and this attack succeeds, deal 2 damage to a different enemy at your location with a fight value equal to or lower than that of the attacked enemy.

cards.name: Marked for Exposure
cards.text: [free] Exhaust Marked for Exposure and place 1 of your clues on your location: Choose an enemy at your location. That enemy gets –1 fight and –1 evade until the end of the round.

cards.name: Patrol Officer
cards.text: [reaction] When Patrol Officer enters or leaves play: Choose an enemy at your location or a connecting location. Move to that enemy’s location and engage it. Until the end of the round, ignore the retaliate keyword when attacking that enemy.

cards.name: Armor Piercing Rounds
cards.text: Uses (2 ammo). Attach to a Firearm asset you control. [action] Spend 1 ammo: Resolve an [action] ability on the attached asset, ignoring all costs. If a Fight action is performed against an enemy with a fight value of 4 or more, this attack deals +2 damage. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Lethal Lesson
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn and if you have defeated at least 1 enemy this round.
During the enemy phase this round, non-<trait>Elite</trait> enemies cannot attack you or move into your location.
cards.flavor: “Let that be a warning.”

cards.name: Pull the Place Apart
cards.text: As an additional cost to play this card, take 1 damage. Investigate ([combat]). If this test is successful, discover 1 additional clue at your location.
cards.flavor: If they didn’t want me breaking things, they shouldn’t have hidden the evidence under the floorboards.

cards.name: Resourcefulness
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn. As an additional cost to play this card, discard an <trait>Item</trait> asset you control.
Play an <trait>Item</trait> asset from your hand, reducing its cost by X, where X is the printed cost of the discarded asset.

cards.name: Looting
cards.text: If this skill test is successful, replenish up to 2 ammo or supply tokens on an asset you control.
cards.flavor: "Now look at what I found here…"

cards.name: Technician
cards.text: If this test is successful, search the top 6 cards of your deck for a <trait>Tool</trait> or <trait>Upgrade</trait> card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Gear Assignment
cards.text:
Attach to an <trait>Ally</trait> asset you control. You have 1 additional hand slot, which can only be used to hold <trait>Item</trait> assets.
[reaction] When Gear Assignment enters play: You may play an <trait>Item</trait> asset from your hand, without paying its cost.

cards.name: Ithaca 37.
cards.text: Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If this attack succeeds, for each point you succeeded by, you may deal 1 damage (to a maximum of 2) to a different enemy at your location with a fight value equal to or lower than that of the attacked enemy.

cards.name: Marked for Exposure
cards.text: [free] Exhaust Marked for Exposure and place 1 of your clues on your location: Choose an enemy at your location. Until the end of the round, that enemy gets –1 fight, –1 evade, and takes 1 additional damage each time it is dealt damage.

cards.name: Trench Knife
cards.text: Engage actions you perform do not provoke attacks of opportunity. [action]: Fight. You get +X [combat] for this attack. X is the number of enemies engaged with you. [reaction] When you engage an enemy, exhaust Trench Knife: Trigger its [action] ability without paying its cost.

cards.name: Ward-etched Skin
cards.text:
Non-direct damage and non-direct horror assigned to you are considered direct damage and direct horror.
You get +1 [willpower], +2 health, and +2 sanity.
[reaction] When you would be defeated by damage or horror, you may immediately discard Ward-etched Skin: Cancel up to 3 of that damage and/or horror.

cards.name: Evidence in Blood
cards.text: If this test is successful during an attack or evasion attempt, discover 1 clue at your location for each enemy defeated this round (max 2 clues).
cards.flavor: “Every corpse tells a story… and I know how to read them.”

cards.name: Sister Aurelia
cards.text:
[action] Exhaust Sister Aurelia: Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from an investigator or <trait>Ally</trait> asset at your location.
[reaction] When one of your card effects heals damage and/or horror from any source: The next skill test performed at your location this round gets –X difficulty, where X is the total amount healed. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Dual Wielding
cards.text: Fast. Play only during your turn if you control at least 2 Weapon assets. Choose 2 Weapon assets you control. Resolve a Fight ability on each of those assets in any order, ignoring all [action] costs. Each of those skill tests gets +X [combat], where X is the total number of [combat] icons on the chosen assets.
cards.flavor: One shot to stagger, one shot to end it.

cards.name: Bandolier
cards.text:
You have 2 additional hand slots, which can only be used to hold <trait>Weapon</trait> assets.
While you have <trait>Weapon</trait> assets held in 2 or more hand slots, you get +1 [combat] and +1 [willpower].
Your Firearm assets with "Uses (ammo)" enter play with 1 additional ammo on them.

cards.name: Agnes Baker
cards.text:
[reaction] When a chaos token is sealed on a card you control (limit once per round):
- If the sealed token has a negative modifier, deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
- If the sealed token has a positive or neutral modifier, discover 1 clue at your location.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may release a chaos token sealed on a card you control. Then, you may choose and seal a different non-[auto_fail] chaos token on that card.
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 25. Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, cards with "seal" level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Heirloom of Hyperborea, Dark Memory, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: Agnes Baker may be just an unassuming waitress in this life, but in a previous life, in a time and age undreamed of in the modern world, she had been a powerful witch. It began when she found a strange artifact - a key of some kind - in a dusty collection of family belongings in her attic. When she touched it, the memories came flooding back, along with one word: "Hyperborea." The more she delved into the visions and memories of her former life, the stronger her powers grew... and the more frightened she became.

cards.name: Heirloom of Hyperborea
cards.text: Agnes Baker deck only. Advanced. Seal (0 or -1). [reaction] If Heirloom of Hyperborea is ready, after a "0" or "-1" chaos token has been resolved during a skill test on a Spell card you control: Seal that token on this card. (Max 3 tokens sealed.) [reaction] When you would reveal a token from the chaos bag during a skill test on a Spell card you control, exhaust Heirloom of Hyperborea: Reveal a token sealed here instead, then release that token.

cards.name: Dark Memory
cards.text: Agnes Baker deck only. Advanced. Revelation - Put Dark Memory into play in your threat area, with 3 charges on it. It cannot leave play while it has 1 or more charges on it. Forced - When you would succeed at a skill test on an ability printed on a Spell card you control, reveal an additional token for that tets and remove 1 charge from Dark Memory. Then, if Dark Memory has no charges on it, discard it. (Limit once per test.)

cards.name: Eyes Through the Veil
cards.text: Uses (5 charges). [action] If Eyes Through the Veil is ready, spend 1 charge: Investigate ([willpower]). After you reveal a chaos token for this test, you may reveal 1 additional token. If you revealed an additional token this way and the test is successful, discover 1 additional clue at your location. If a non-[elder_sign] symbol token is revealed during this test, exhaust Eyes Through the Veil.

cards.name: Master of Secrets
cards.text: [reaction] After you investigate, if no token is sealed here, exhaust Master of Secrets: Seal a non-[auto_fail] token revealed during that test. If you seal a "+0," "+1," or [elder_sign] token this way, discover 1 clue at your location. Forced - At the end of the round, if Master of Secrets has a sealed token on it: You must either place 1 doom on Master of Secrets or release that token.

cards.name: Professor Cyrus Delane
cards.text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After an asset that takes up an arcane slot enters or leaves play under your control, exhaust Professor Cyrus Delane: Draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: “It’s not magic. It’s language.”

cards.name: Soporific Grimoire
cards.text: [action] Exhaust Soporific Grimoire: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location. Test [intellect] (X), where X is the enemy's fight value. If this test is successful, exhaust that enemy. (It does not disengage.)
cards.flavor: The words within turn fury into drowsy whispers.

cards.name: Tattoos of the Void
cards.text: [reaction] When a chaos token is sealed on another card you control, if Tattoos of the Void has no sealed tokens on it: Seal an identical token on Tattoos of the Void. Forced - At the start of the round, if Tattoos of the Void has a sealed token and no other card you control has a matching token sealed on it: Take 1 horror or release the sealed token on Tattoos of the Void.

cards.name: Burden of Souls
cards.text: Move up to 3 horror from an investigator at your location onto you and/or assets you control, split in any way. For each horror moved this way, deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
cards.flavor: "I will bear your pain, for I have walked through darkness before."

cards.name: Inscription of Power
cards.text: Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. Attached location cannot be investigated. Each non-Elite enemy at the attached location gets -1 fight and -1 evade. Forced - At the end of the round, if there are no investigators at attached location: Discard Inscription of Power.

cards.name: Spellshifting
cards.text: Move up to 3 charges from one asset you control, onto another asset at your location. For each charge moved this way, gain 1 resource.
cards.flavor: Power never vanishes. It only finds a new shape.

cards.name: Imbue
cards.text:
If this test is successful during a skill test from an ability printed on a <trait>Spell</trait> asset you control, attach Imbue to that <trait>Spell</trait> asset.
The attached asset gains: "[action] Discard Imbue: Return this asset to your hand."
cards.flavor: The magic lingers, ready to be woven anew.

cards.name: Bind the Pulse of Time
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn if you sealed, canceled, or ignored 1 or more chaos tokens this round.
Choose an asset you control that has an [action] ability with an Investigate, Fight, or Evade action. Resolve that ability, ignoring all costs.

cards.name: Price of Clarity
cards.text:
As an additional cost to commit Price of Clarity to a skill test, take up to 3 horror. For each horror you take in this way, Price of Clarity gains a [wild] for this test.
If you have 3 or less remaining sanity after this test resolves, heal 2 horror.

cards.name: Forbidden Knowledge
cards.text: Uses (4 secrets). If Forbidden Knowledge has no secrets, discard it. [free] Exhaust Forbidden Knowledge and take 1 horror: Move 1 secret from Forbidden Knowledge to your resource pool, as a resource. Forced - After Forbidden Knowledge leaves play: Heal 2 horror and draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Vessel of Agonies
cards.text:
Uses (0 charges).
[reaction] After you take 1 or more horror: Place 1 charge on Vessel of Agonies.
[free] Spend 3 charges: Deal 3 damage to an enemy at your location. You may remove Vessel of Agonies from the game to heal 2 horror from an investigator at your location.

cards.name: Drawn by Prophecy
cards.text: Investigate ([willpower]). When this test begins, name a chaos token. Reveal 3 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose 1 to resolve and ignore the others. If the chosen token matches the named token, and the test is successful, discover 2 additional clues at your location. For each non-[elder_sign] symbol token revealed during this test, lose 1 resource.

cards.name: Blessing of the Occult
cards.text: Uses (5 charges). If Blessing of the Occult has no charges, discard it. [reaction] After you reveal a non-[auto_fail] chaos token, spend 1 charge: Treat that token as a [skull] token instead. Forced - After Blessing of the Occult leaves play: Each investigator at your location or a connecting location may choose to either heal 1 horror or draw 1 card.

cards.name: Eyes Through the Veil
cards.text: Uses (5 charges). [action] If Eyes Through the Veil is ready, spend 1 charge: Investigate ([willpower]). Your location gets -2 shroud for this investigation. After you reveal the initial chaos token for this test, you may choose to reveal up to 2 additional chaos tokens, one at a time. If the test succeeds, for each additional token revealed this way, you may discover 1 additional clue at your location. If a non-[elder_sign] symbol token is revealed during this test, exhaust Eyes Through the Veil.

cards.name: Fearless
cards.text: If this skill test is successful, heal 1 horror from an investigator at your location (2 horror instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).
cards.flavor: Only by standing firm against the darkness can we live to see the light of another day.

cards.name: Inscription of Power
cards.text:
Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. Attached location cannot be investigated.
Attached location gains: "[action]: Test [willpower] (5). If you succeed, return Inscription of Power to its owner's hand."
Each investigator at the attached location gets +2 [willpower]. Each enemy at the attached location gets -2 fight and -2 evade.

cards.name: Yithian
cards.text:
Each of your <trait>Ally</trait> assets gains the <trait>Yithian</trait> trait.
[reaction] After you commit a card to a skill test you are performing: Double the skill icons on that card. (Limit once per test.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Draw 1 card.
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Cards level 0-2* from any class. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Thirst for Knowledge, Forgotten Knowledge, 1 random basic weakness. Additional Requirements: Your deck must include cards with at least 4 unique Traits, with a minimum of 5 cards for each of those Traits (20 cards total). Additional Options: * Increase the level limit for cards by (X – 4) (to a maximum of 3), where X is the number of unique traits that are included on at least 5 of your cards in your deck
cards.back_flavor: As a child, you never thought of yourself as an adventurous Yithian, like Yithian the Great, Achillythian or even Neilythian Clawstrong, but you knew everything about their prowesses. Knowing things was your thing. Never enough knowledge could satisfy your mind. So you kept learning until eventually you learned everything there was to know about your world. What’s next then, you wondered？ Was it time for you to learn about other worlds？ Will your infinite thirst for knowledge finally make a adventurous Yithian explorer of yourself？

cards.name: Thirst for Knowledge
cards.text:
Permanent. Yithian only.
You can only play, commit, or trigger abilities on player cards if all the <trait>Traits</trait> on that card have been learned and/or are printed on your investigator.
[action] Reveal a non-weakness card from your hand, or choose a non-weakness card you control, and choose one of its <trait>Traits</trait>: Test [intellect] (X). X is equal to half the <trait>Traits</trait> you have learned (rounded up). If you fail, discard that card. If you succeed, record that you have learned that <trait>Trait</trait>.

cards.name: Forgotten Knowledge
cards.text: Revelation - Forget 1 learned Trait of your choice (crossing it off from your records). Then, discard a card with that Trait from your hand or play area. If you cannot, take 1 horror instead. If you have not learned any Traits, shuffle Forgotten Knowledge back into your deck instead.
cards.flavor: What was once clear fades into shadow, slipping from your mind like water through trembling tendrils.

cards.name: Bait
cards.text: Uses (2 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Parley. Automatically evade a non-Elite Monster or Creature enemy engaged with an investigator at your location.

cards.name: Forgotten Blueprint
cards.text: [action] Exhaust Forgotten Blueprint and another non-permanent neutral asset you control: Draw 2 cards. If you exhausted Old Schematics as part of this action, you may instead draw 3 cards, then choose and discard a card from your hand.
cards.flavor: Tucked behind a false panel in the library wall, the parchment was brittle with age, and brimming with revelation.

cards.name: Old Schematics
cards.text: [action] Exhaust Old Schematics and another non-permanent neutral asset you control: Move. Move up to 2 times. If you exhausted Forgotten Blueprint as part of this action, this action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
cards.flavor: Each scribbled note told of a shortcut long forgotten… or wisely abandoned.

cards.name: Bait
cards.text: Uses (2 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Parley. Automatically evade a non-Elite Monster or Creature enemy engaged with an investigator at your location. You may also move that enemy to a connecting location.

cards.name: Kukri
cards.text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If you succeed, you may spend 1 additional action to deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.

cards.name: Recursive Directive
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Resolve an [action] ability on two different non-weakness neutral assets you control, ignoring their [action] cost. Those assets do not exhaust as part of their ability’s cost.
If the chosen assets were Forgotten Blueprint and Old Schematics, add Recursive Directive to the victory display. Otherwise, remove it from the game.

cards.name: Bound to You
cards.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase only at deck creation.
Before drawing your opening hand, search your deck for your signature card and add it to your hand. Then shuffle your deck and draw 4 cards as your opening hand.
You may not mulligan cards in your opening hand. Weaknesses drawn this way must remain in your hand.

cards.name: Collateral Damage
cards.text: Permanent. Group limit 1 in play. Purchase only at deck creation. When an investigator performs a Fight action against an enemy engaged with another investigator, that skill test gets +1 difficulty. If the attack fails, the engaged investigator may test [agility] (X), where X is the amount the attack failed by. If they succeed, the engaged investigator takes no damage from the failed attack.

cards.name: Pact of Endurance
cards.text: Permanent. Group limit 1 in play. Purchase only at deck creation. When an investigator is dealt damage or horror, all of that damage or horror must be assigned to a single card. If the chosen card does not have a printed health or sanity value (e.g. Leather Coat or Cherished Keepsake), then any portion of the damage or horror that cannot be assigned to the initially chosen card must be assigned to another card. Otherwise, any excess damage or horror is not assigned elsewhere and is instead lost.

cards.name: Reversal of Signs
cards.text: Permanent. Group limit 1 in play. Purchase only at deck creation. [reaction] When a [auto_fail] is revealed during a skill test: Cancel that chaos token, return it to the token pool, and reveal another token. (Group limit once per game.) Forced - The first time an [elder_sign] token is revealed during a skill test this game: Cancel that chaos token, return it to the token pool, and reveal another token.

cards.name: The Elder Sign
cards.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase only at deck creation. Uses (3 signs).
[free] If you are playing true solo, exhaust The Elder Sign and spend 1 sign. Choose one:
- Move to a connecting location.
- You get +2 skill value for your next skill test this round.
- Gain 1 additional action this turn, which may only be used to activate an [action] ability on a scenario card in play.
[free] Draw the top card of the encounter deck: Replenish 2 uses on The Elder Sign.

cards.name: The Thirteenth Appendix
cards.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase only at deck creation.
Your deck size is increased by 5. When you draw your opening hand, you may take an additional mulligan.

cards.name: Broken Seal
cards.text: Broken Seal can only be included in your deck if your deck contains at least 3 cards that take up one or more accessory and/or arcane slots. Revelation - Return 2 cards in play that take up 1 or more accessory and/or arcane slots to your hand. Put Broken Seal into play in your threat area. It cannot leave play except by using the ability below. [free] Discard a card from your hand that takes up at 1 or more accessory and/or arcane slot: Discard Broken Seal.

cards.name: Slippery Grip
cards.text: Slippery Grip can only be included in your deck if your deck contains at least 3 cards that take up one or more hand slots. Revelation - Return 2 cards in play that take up 1 or more hand slots to your hand. Put Slippery Grip into play in your threat area. It cannot leave play except by using the ability below. [free] Discard a card from your hand that takes up at 1 or more hand slot: Discard Slippery Grip.

cards.name: Turned Coat
cards.text: Turned Coat can only be included in your deck if your deck contains at least 3 cards that take up one or more ally and/or body slots. Revelation - Return 2 cards in play that take up 1 or more ally and/or body slots to your hand. Put Turned Coat into play in your threat area. It cannot leave play except by using the ability below. [free] Discard a card from your hand that takes up at 1 or more ally and/or body slot: Discard Turned Coat.

cards.name: "Skids" O'Toole
cards.text:
You may take an additional action each turn to play a card that costs 3 or more resources.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Gain resources equal to the amount of actions you have spent this round (to a maximum of 4).
cards.flavor: "I'm not proud of the shortcuts I've taken in life, but I never regretted a single one."
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, up to five Guardian ([guardian]) cards level 0-1, up to five Survivor ([survivor]) cards level 0-1, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): On the Lam, Hospital Debts, 1 random basic weakness. Deckbuilding Restrictions: No Police cards.
cards.back_flavor: Skids hadn't planned on a life of crime. But sometimes doing the right thing means getting your hands dirty. His cellmate, Brad Hollins, would rant and rave about the "Old Ones". Skids didn't give it much thought until the night he woke to the sight of his cellmate bursting into flames. When Skids was finally released, he returned to Arkham, looking for answers.

cards.name: On the Lam
cards.text: "Skids" O'Toole deck only. Advanced. Forced - At the end of your turn: Place 1 resource on On the Lam for each action you spent beyond 3 this round. Resources on On the Lam may be used to pay for cards as if they were in your resource pool.

cards.name: Hospital Debts
cards.text: "Skids" O'Toole deck only. Advanced. Revelation - Put Hospital Debts into play in your threat area, with 3 resources on it as debt. It cannot leave play while it has 1 or more resources on it. Forced - When you would play a card: Increase the cost of that card by 2 and remove 1 resource from Hospital Debts. Then, if Hospital Debts has no resources on it, discard it.

cards.name: Informant
cards.text: [reaction] When you initiate a skill test, exhaust Informant: You may contribute it's skill icons to this test. If this test fails by 2 or more, discard Informant. If you succeed by 2 or more, ready Informant.

cards.name: Molly Brown
cards.text:
[reaction] When Molly Brown enters play: Gain 2 resources for each other <trait>Ally</trait> asset you control.
[reaction] When Molly Brown leaves play: Choose an <trait>Ally</trait> asset in your discard pile. Return it to your hand.

cards.name: Flash of Wealth
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn and if you spent 5 or more resources this round.
Search the top X cards of your deck for a card, where X is the number of resources spent this round, and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Intimidate
cards.text: Evade ([combat]). If you succeed by 2 or more, until the end of the round, you get +2 skill value while performing skill tests during attacks against that enemy.
cards.flavor: "I don't fight fair. I don't have to."

cards.name: Last-Ditch Effort
cards.text: As an additional cost to play Last-Ditch Effort, place 1 of your clues on your location. Investigate. If this test is successful, discover 2 additional clues at your location.

cards.name: Lucky Strike
cards.text: Fast. Play when an enemy makes an attack of opportunity against you. Cancel that attack. Evade. Attempt to evade the attacking enemy. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to it.

cards.name: Smoke Bomb
cards.text: Attach this card to your location. When you play Smoke Bomb, disengage all enemies from investigators at your location. Enemies at attached location cannot engage investigators and cannot move from this location. Investigators at attached location get -2 to all skill tests. Forced - At the end of the round, if Smoke Bomb is attached to a location: Discard it.

cards.name: "Keep Blastin'"
cards.text:
Commit only to a skill test during an attack with a <trait>Firearm</trait> asset.
If this skill test is successful, you may deal 2 damage to another enemy at your location.

cards.name: Rock Bottom
cards.text:
While you have 1 or fewer resources, you may commit this card from your discard pile. 
After resolving the skill test, if this card was committed from the discard pile, place it at the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavor: When you’ve hit rock bottom, the only way is up.

cards.name: Bribed Silence
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Chose an enemy at your location. Resolve the following effects based on the amount of resources spent to play this card:
- If X is 2 or more: Until the end of the round, the next time that enemy attacks, cancel that attack.
- If X is 4 or more: Until the end of the round, investigators ignore the alert and retaliate keywords on that enemy.
- If X is 6 or more: Disengage from that enemy and move up to two locations away.

cards.name: Inside Job
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
As an additional cost to play Inside Job, ready an exhausted enemy at your location.
Discover up to 2 clues from your location.
cards.flavor: If anyone asks, you were never there.

cards.name: Last-Ditch Effort
cards.text: As an additional cost to play Last-Ditch Effort, place 1 of your clues on your location. Investigate. You may investigate using [agility] instead of [intellect]. If this test is successful, discover 2 additional clues at your location or a connecting location. If you succeed by 2 or more, discover 3 additional clues instead.

cards.name: Negotiations
cards.text: Parley. Reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If you revealed: - A positive number or [elder_sign] token: Play a card from your hand without paying for its cost. - A negative number: Search your deck or discard pile for an Illicit or Criminal card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. - A non-[elder_sign] symbol token: Either discard 2 cards or 3 resources.

cards.name: Bloodwire
cards.text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[reaction] After an enemy readies at your location: Deal 1 damage to that enemy. If that enemy is defeated by this effect, gain 1 resource. (Limit once per enemy per round.)

cards.name: Burglary
cards.text: [action] Exhaust Burglary: Investigate ([agility]). If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, gain 2 resources, +1 additional resource for each point you succeed by (to a maximum of +3 resources).

cards.name: Pickpocketing
cards.text:
Fast.
You get +1 [agility] during evasion attempts.
[reaction] After you evade an enemy, exhaust Pickpocketing: Draw 1 card or gain 1 resource. If you succeeded by 2 or more, do both instead. Once per turn, if you succeed by 3 or more, you may take an additional action this turn.

cards.name: Stolen Idol of Yoth
cards.text: Limit 1 per deck. Uses (0 secrets). When you purchase this card, choose 1 chaos token in the chaos bag and record chosen token has been marked by Yoth in your campaign log. Then, search your bonded cards for 1 copy of Issith and add it to your deck. It does not count toward your deck size. [reaction] After you reveal the chosen token during a skill test: Place 1 secret on this card. Then, if Stolen Idol of Yoth has 5 or more secrets on it, place it in the victory display. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Flash of Wealth
cards.text: Fast. Play only during your turn and if you spent 5 or more resources this round. Search the top X cards of your deck for a card, where X is the number of resources spent this round, and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. Then, repeat this process two more times. You may immediately play 1 of the 3 cards added to your hand this way (paying its cost). Remove Flash of Wealth from the game.

cards.name: Issith
cards.text: Bonded (Stolen Idol of Yoth). Prey - Bearer. Alert. Hunter. Forced - After you reveal the chosen chaos token during a skill test: Ready Issith and resolve its hunter keyword. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Daisy Walker
cards.text:
[reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues from a non-basic investigate action: Look at the top 2 cards of the encounter deck. You may choose 1 to place on the bottom of the encounter deck. Return the rest to the top of the encounter deck in any order. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. Choose and discard a non-weakness treachery card in the threat area of an investigator at your location.
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, up to five Mystic ([mystic]) cards level 0-1, up to five Survivor ([survivor]) cards level 0-1, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Daisy’s Tote Bag, The Necronomicon (John Dee Translation), 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: As a respected librarian at Miskatonic University, Daisy had always felt that books were the most important thing in her life. She explored in fiction what she abhorred in life: horror, violence, fear. Then, she stumbled across the John Dee translation of the Necronomicon. It was blasphemous, unholy, and too awful to be read. But given her studies in obscure and occult subjects, Daisy knew there was more truth than fiction within the book's pages. She began to wonder what other secrets the restricted collection of the Orne Library held...

cards.name: Daisy's Tote Bag
cards.text:
Daisy Walker deck only. Advanced. Uses (3 books).
[free] During a skill test on a non-weakness treachery being performed by an investigator at your location, exhaust Daisy's Tote Bag and spend 1 book: That investigator gets +2 skill value for that test.
[action]: Replenish 1 book token on Daisy’s Tote Bag and ready it.

cards.name: The Necronomicon
cards.text: Daisy Walker deck only. Advanced. Revelation - Put The Necronomicon into play in your threat area, with 3 horror on it. It cannot leave play while it has 1 or more horror on it. Forced - The first time you draw an encounter card each round: Either move 1 horror from The Necronomicon to Daisy Walker, or draw an additional encounter card. If you drew an additional encounter card, remove 1 horror from The Necronomicon. Then, if The Necronomicon has no horror on it, discard it.

cards.name: Eldritch Insight
cards.text: Uses (4 charges and 1 secret). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Your location gets -1 shroud for each secret on this card for this investigation.

cards.name: Bookmark
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to a <trait>Tome</trait> asset you control. Limit 1 per asset.
[free] Exhaust Bookmark and the attached asset: You may contribute the icons of the attached asset to this skill test. If this test fails, discard Bookmark.

cards.name: Flight or Fright
cards.text: Play only if you are engaged to an enemy. Evade. Move to a connecting location either before or after this evasion attempt.
cards.flavor: "Aaaahhhhhhhh!" - Clearly panicking

cards.name: Fortunate Find
cards.text:
Fast. Play when a [elder_sign], "+1," or "0" token is revealed during an investigation.
Choose an asset you control with uses (supply, charge, or secret). Ready that asset if it is exhausted. You may take 1 additional action this turn, which can only be used on an [action] ability on the chosen asset.

cards.name: Proof of Concept
cards.text: Put this card into play in your play area and search the chaos bag for a "0" or "+1" chaos token and seal it on this card. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity. [reaction] When you or another investigator at your location would reveal a chaos token during a skill test: Resolve the token sealed here as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag, instead. Then, discard Proof of Concept. Forced - At the end of the round, if Proof of Concept is in your play area: Discard it.

cards.name: Slip By
cards.text: Fast. Play when you would be engaged by a non-Elite enemy with an evade value equal or lower than the number of clues you have. Until the end of the round, that enemy cannot engage you unless you take a non-Move action at its location.

cards.name: Two Steps Ahead
cards.text:
Play only as your first action. Put this card into play in your play area. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
[reaction] When the investigation phase begins, discard Two Steps Ahead and choose a skill ([willpower], [intellect], [combat] or [agility]): For the remainder of the round, you get +2 to the chosen skill.

cards.name: Inspect
cards.text:
If this test is successful, attach Inspect to the investigated location or evaded enemy.
While attached, Inspect contributes its skill icons to all investigation and evasion tests targeting the attached card.

cards.name: Shared Insight
cards.text: This card can only be committed to a skill test being performed by another investigator either at your location, or at a connecting location. If this skill test succeeds by 2 or more, return this card to your hand.
cards.flavor: "Sometimes all you need is a different perspective to solve the problem."

cards.name: Seed of Clarity
cards.text:
Exceptional. Fast.
[reaction] When Seed of Clarity enters play: Search your bonded cards for 1 copy of Revelation of Purpose and shuffle it into the encounter deck.
[reaction] When Revelation of Purpose is revealed: You may shuffle Seed of Clarity back into your deck and heal 1 horror.

cards.name: Revelation of Purpose
cards.text: Bonded (Seed of Clarity). Revelation - Search the top 6 cards of your deck for any card and draw it. Until the end of the round, reduce the cost of that card by 2. Shuffle your deck. Then, set this card aside out of play.

cards.name: Slipstream Theorem
cards.text: [action] Exhaust Slipstream Theorem: Investigate. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, automatically evade an enemy at your location.
cards.flavor: To step between the moments is to walk unseen—and to walk unseen is to be free.

cards.name: Fortunate Find
cards.text:
Fast. Play when a [elder_sign], "+1," or "0" token is revealed during an investigation.
Choose an asset you control with uses (supply, charge, or secret). Ready that asset if it is exhausted. Place either 1 supply, charge, or secret on that asset. You may take 1 additional action this turn, which can only be used on an [action] ability on the chosen asset.

cards.name: Pattern Recognition
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Name a <trait>Trait</trait>. Look at the top card of the encounter deck. If it has the named <trait>Trait</trait>, discard it. Then, search the encounter deck for any number of cards with the same title and discard them. Shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Seeking Knowledge
cards.text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[reaction] After you enter a location with 4 or more shroud, exhaust Seeking Knowledge: Immediately take a basic action.
cards.flavor: Wisdom is not a product of schooling but of the lifelong attempt to acquire it.

cards.name: Archivist's Lens
cards.text:
Uses (2 secrets).
[reaction] After you look at 1 or more cards from the encounter deck or your deck, exhaust Archivist's Lens: Place 1 secret on it.
[free] Spend 3 secrets: Search your bonded cards for 1 copy of Focused Field and add it to your hand.

cards.name: Eldritch Insight
cards.text: Uses (4 charges and 3 secrets). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Your location gets -1 shroud for each secret on this card for this investigation. [free] During a skill test you are performing: Spend 1 secret to gain +1 to any skill value for this test.

cards.name: In the Know
cards.text: Uses (5 secrets). [action] Spend 1 or more secrets: Investigate. Investigate any revealed location in play as if you were at that location. For each secret spent, you get +1 [intellect] for this test.

cards.name: Deduction
cards.text:
If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, if you succeed by…
- …1 or less: Discover 1 additional clue at that location.
- …exactly 2: Discover 2 additional clues at that location.
- …3 or more: Discover 2 additional clues at that location or a connecting location.

cards.name: Focused Field
cards.text: Bonded (Archivist's Lens). Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location. Attached location gains: “[reaction] When you would draw a card during the investigation phase: Search the top 3 cards of your deck for any card and draw it instead. Shuffle your deck. (Group limit once per round)” Forced - At the end of the round, if there are no investigators at attached location: Set Focused Field aside out of play.

cards.name: Wendy Adams
cards.text:
[reaction] When a <trait>Fortune</trait> card you control would be discarded: Shuffle that card into your deck instead. Then, draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Search the top 6 cards of your deck for an <trait>Fortune</trait> card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "My luck will turn around one day, I know it will."
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-2, Fortune cards level 0-3, Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Wendy's Amulet, Abandoned and Alone, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: Mama used to let Wendy play with her necklace when she was small. Mama would tell her stories, and Wendy would spin the necklace and watch as it glittered. Then, word came that her father had been lost at sea, and Mama started acting strange, drawing unusual symbols in chalk all over the house. They took Mama to the asylum, and Wendy went to the orphanage. Before they took her away, Mama gave her the necklace, to "protect her." Wendy stayed in the orphanage for several years before running away, deciding that she could take better care of herself on her own.

cards.name: Wendy's Amulet
cards.text:
Wendy Adams deck only. Advanced.
[reaction] When you would discard a card or shuffle a card into your deck due to Wendy Adams's [reaction] ability, exhaust Wendy's Amulet: Place that card beneath Wendy's Amulet instead.
[action]: Draw a card beneath Wendy's Amulet. This action does not cause attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Abandoned and Alone
cards.text: Wendy Adams deck only. Advanced. Revelation - Put Abandoned and Alone into play in your threat area, with 3 horror on it. It cannot leave play while it has 1 or more horror on it. Forced - After you trigger Wendy Adams's [reaction] ability: Move 1 horror from Abandoned and Alone to Wendy Adams. Then, if Abandoned and Alone has no horror on it, discard it.

cards.name: Lumberjack's Axe
cards.text: [action] If Lumberjack's Axe is ready: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. For each previous time you have used this ability this round, you get an additional +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage (to a maximum of +2 [combat] and +2 damage). Forced - After you resolve the [action] ability on Lumberjack’s Axe for the third time in a round: Exhaust Lumberjack’s Axe. It does not ready during your next upkeep phase.

cards.name: Nailed Board
cards.text: Nailed Board can be played from your discard pile for 1 additional resource. [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If you succeed by 2 or less, discard Nailed Board after the attack resolves.
cards.flavor: Sometimes, the house fights back.

cards.name: Rex, Trusty Retriever
cards.text:
Uses (3 dog treats).
[reaction] After an investigator at your location fails a skill test by 2 or less, exhaust Rex, Trusty Retriever and spend 1 dog treat: That investigator searches the top 3 cards of their deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles their deck.
cards.flavor: "Good boy, Rex! Always knows just what I need, even when I don’t."

cards.name: Blind Rage
cards.text: Until the end of the round, the next time an enemy attacks you, cancel that attack and deal that enemy's damage to a non-<trait>Elite</trait> enemy at your location. This action does not cause attacks of opportunity.
cards.flavor: "They're consumed by blind rage, I seen an opportunity to pit them against each other."

cards.name: Ergonomic Grip
cards.text:
Attach to a <trait>Melee</trait> asset you control. Limit 1 per asset.
[free] Exhaust Ergonomic Grip and the attached asset: Resolve an [action] ability on the attached asset, ignoring it's [action] cost.

cards.name: "It Ain't Over"
cards.text:
Fast. Play after an <trait>Ally</trait> asset at your location is discarded or is defeated.
Search your discard pile for an <trait>Item</trait> asset and add it to your hand.
cards.flavor: “Wasn’t much of a legacy, but it’s enough.”

cards.name: Night Camp
cards.text: Play only if there are no enemies at your location. As an additional cost to play Night Camp, spend 1[per_investigator] resource. Attach to your location. Attached location gains "[action]: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror. (Limit once per game.)" Forced - After an enemy enters the attached location: Discard Night Camp.

cards.name: From the Ashes
cards.text: Max 1 committed per skill test. You may commit From the Ashes to any type of test. If this test fails, the performing investigator shuffles their discard pile (without looking) and returns the top 2 cards of their discard pile to their hand.

cards.name: Gambler's Resolve
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, gain 2 resources and discard the top card of your deck. Otherwise, discard the top 3 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor: Sometimes you play for keeps. Sometimes you just play to stay in the game.

cards.name: Weathered Oilskin
cards.text:
You get +1 health and +1 sanity.
[reaction] After you move while engaged with an enemy, exhaust Weathered Oilskin: Automatically evade that enemy.
cards.flavor: "Smells like fish guts and mildew. Saved my skin more times than I can count."

cards.name: Clear the Deck
cards.text:
You may play Clear the Deck from your discard pile. If you do, shuffle it into your deck after resolving its effects.
As an additional cost to play Clear the Deck, you may discard up to 3 cards from your hand. Reduce this card’s cost by 1 for each card discarded this way. Draw 1 card for each card discarded this way.

cards.name: Frayed Token
cards.text: [reaction] When a player card ability would discard a card from your hand or play area, exhaust Frayed Token: Shuffle the card into your deck instead, and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Threads of fate do not fray without reason.

cards.name: Stray Cat
cards.text:
You get +1 [agility].
[free] Discard Stray Cat: Choose a non-<trait>Elite</trait> enemy at your location. Shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck.
cards.flavor: He never came if you called for him. It always seemed like he had his own agenda.

cards.name: Ergonomic Grip
cards.text:
Attach to a <trait>Melee</trait> asset you control. Limit 1 per asset.
[free] Exhaust Ergonomic Grip and the attached asset: Resolve an [action] ability on the attached asset, ignoring it's [action] cost. You get +1 [combat] for this skill test and deal +1 damage.

cards.name: Planted Evidence
cards.text:
Fast. Play after you successfully evade an  enemy. Attach Planted Evidence to that enemy. Limit 1 per enemy.
Attached enemy gains: "[reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues from your location and this enemy is exhausted: Discover 1 additional clue. (Limit once per round.)"

cards.name: Junkyard Instinct
cards.text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[reaction] When you would play a card from your discard pile, exhaust Junkyard Instinct: Reduce the cost of that card by 1.
[free] Discard Junkyard Instinct: Play a card from your discard pile. Reduce its cost by 1.

cards.name: Butterfly Effect
cards.text: Fast. Play when a chaos token with a symbol is revealed during a skill test at your location (before resolving its effects). Investigators at your location may commit any number of cards to this skill test and/or return any number of cards they committed to this test to their hand.

cards.name: Tenacious Resolve
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
[reaction] While Tenacious Resolve is in your discard pile, if you add another card from your discard pile to your hand or play a card from your discard pile: Return Tenacious Resolve to your hand. (Max once per round.)

packs.name: Unofficial Return to Night of the Zealot - Investigator Expansion
